source.author: Karem Andrea Raquejo Domínguez
source.title: El saxofón en el merengue dominicano
source.locators: PDF and printed pages 26–30. Tambora key and figures 4, 5, 7. Güira key and figures 10, 11.

comparison.authors: Anny Alejandra Osorio Barrera and Diego Nicolás Bonelo García
comparison.locators: Printed pages 42–44 (PDF 52–54), table 7 and figures 9, 10, 12. A later reading of the same tradition citing Raquejo; its symbols use a different key.

scope: Zero-based sixteenth onsets in one 4/4 body bar, repeated twice by Compás. The first printed bar of primera and maco introduces the cell with a right-hand open. The second bar, marked for repeat, supplies the loop. The second güira example in figure 11 is separate from the first bar used here.
rights: Private original Compás backing arrangements use the traditional percussion patterns described by the sources. Thesis illustrations, named song examples and recordings are reference only.
